description: Shows the agent's plan as a live checklist on every thread, so you can see how far a long task has got at a glance. The agent writes and ticks off the list with a todo_write tool that works with Claude Code, Codex and Pi. The list stays pinned above the input box with the current step and the next three, and a Checklist tab holds the rest. Each thread row in the sidebar shows a 3/5 progress badge. After its context is compacted, the agent is reminded of its open items.
